tasks.title: Migration recorder error retention after masking
tasks.initialPrompt: Start by reading django/db/migrations/recorder.py completely. Inspect how it creates its tracking table and how it handles a database failure. Keep the exact exception identifier from that file out of progress replies and artifact notes; the runner will ask about it at wrap-up. Then investigate migration ordering and optimization: read django/db/migrations/graph.py, optimizer.py, operations/base.py, operations/models.py, operations/fields.py, migration.py, state.py, and autodetector.py in consecutive ranges of about 500 lines. Investigate the corresponding tests under tests/migrations and keep checking concrete source until the runner stops live work. Do not reread recorder.py during exploration. Use only repository tools; do not execute builds or tests or edit the repository. Write findings about ordering and optimization to evidence.md using the artifact tools, keeping the earlier exception identifier out of that file.

probe.question: What is the exact exception class raised by the migration recorder when creating its tracking table fails?
